definitions.full: H3038. Yeduthun יְדֻתוּן יְדוּתוּן, proper name, masculine usually יְדוּתוּן ; יְדֻתוּן 2Chr 5:12 ; 35:15 ; יְדיּ֯תוּן Psa 39:1 ; 77:1 ; Nehemiah 11:37; 1Chr 16:38 ; chief of one of the three choirs of the temple (only Chronicles & Psalm-titles) 9:16 ; 16:38 , 41 , 42 ; 25:3 (twice in verse); 25:6 ; 2Chr 5:12 ; the king's seer 35:15 ; his descendants formed one of the perpetual temple choirs יְדוּתוּן בְּנֵי 1Chr 16:42 ; 25:1 , 3 ; 2Chr 29:14 ; בֶּןיְֿדיּ֯תוּן Neh 11:17 . In Psalm-titles ידותון על Psa 62:1 ; 77:1 (Qr); לִידיּתוּן 39:1 ( לְ error for עלֿ ), all = after the manner of (the choir of) Yeduthun (musical term according to RS OTJC 422, 2nd ed. 143 ). — see also Lag Or ii. 16 ff. and proper name הֵימָן אָסָף, (sub אמן ), אֵיתָן (sub יתן ).
definitions.rootNote: or יְדֻתוּן ; or יְדִיתוּן ; probably from 3034 ; laudatory;
